comments.content: Empty stub exits 0: file contains only shebang + duplicated `set -e` with no scan logic. Verified `gates.yml:theatrical_verification` implements the check inline and no code references this script, so it is currently dead code — but if later wired to `gates/theatrical-verification` it would vacuously pass. Either implement the scan (mirroring the inline grep logic) or delete the file.
comments.suggestion_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# TODO: implement theatrical-verification scan or remove this stub.
# Currently unused — .github/workflows/gates.yml implements the check inline.
exit 1

comments.content: Unconditional PUT even on idempotent no-op: patch script prints `patched: False` but still PUTs `$PATCHED`. This adds a needless live-ruleset write (race window) on every re-run. Skip the PUT when nothing changed and fail closed if the new context is absent after PUT (currently only prints count).
comments.suggestion_code:
if python3 - "$PATCHED" "$NEW_CONTEXT" <<'EOF'
import json,sys
rs=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
checks=[c.get("context") for r in rs.get("rules",[]) if r.get("type")=="required_status_checks" for c in r.get("parameters",{}).get("required_status_checks",[])]
sys.exit(0 if sys.argv[2] in checks else 1)
EOF
then
  gh api -X PUT "repos/$REPO/rulesets/$RULESET_ID" --input "$PATCHED" > "$RESULT"
fi

comments.content: Fragile verification indexing: `r["parameters"]["required_status_checks"]` will raise KeyError if a rule lacks those keys, unlike the defensive `setdefault`/`get` used in the patch step above and the `?.`/`?? []` pattern in `scripts/interface-check.ts`. Use `.get()` guards so a malformed GET response produces a clear error instead of a traceback under `set -e`.
Narrow ignore: `gates/__pycache__/` only covers one directory. Python bytecode can appear in any package (`scripts/`, root, etc.). Prefer `**/__pycache__/` + `*.py[cod]` to avoid future leakage.
comments.suggestion_code:
**/__pycache__/
*.py[cod]

comments.content: Dynamic import, spread of REQUIRED_CONTEXTS, and JSON.parse have no try/catch or shape validation. A missing export, syntax error, or invalid JSON throws an unhandled rejection instead of the documented exit 2 (cannot-measure), conflating disagreement (exit 1) with unmeasured. Validate Array.isArray(mod.REQUIRED_CONTEXTS) and wrap import/parse in try/catch exiting 2, as done in tests/interface_match.test.ts.

Explicit `any` without justification (r:any/c:any) and unvalidated projection `ruleset.rules ?? []` / `c.context`. A malformed rule (null, missing parameters) yields undefined entries in `got`, causing false MISSING/EXTRA. Type as `unknown` with narrowing per tests/interface_match.test.ts.

// narrow unknown -> string contexts with Array.isArray / typeof checks (see tests/interface_match.test.ts)

comments.content: readFileSync(specPath) has no existsSync guard or try/catch, so a missing default spec throws raw ENOENT with stack trace and no VERDICT line instead of fail-closed exit 2. The fixed scripts/spec-audit.ts and tests/spec_audit.test.ts require SPEC-AUDIT-ERROR:spec-missing + exit 2. Add the same guard before reading.

CWD-relative resolution is inconsistent with the other gates: specPath/missionPath defaults (`../packages/...`) and `existsSync("tests")/readdirSync("tests")` depend on CWD, while interface-check.ts/spec-diff.ts anchor to import.meta.dir/ROOT. Invoking from repo root vs scripts/ changes behavior and GS-4 can falsely report TEST-SHAPE-DRIFT. Resolve against import.meta.dir like the other two scripts.

Dead code + stale heuristic: `mission` is read but never used, while GS-3/GS-7 hardcode NOUNS graph/comms/filepaths/guardrail. On mission change the noun list drifts silently. Either derive nouns from the mission file or remove the read.

comments.content: Rule 3 is file-wide correlation: if any `check|verify|gate|assert|validate|ensure` function exists anywhere, every `?? 0|""|[]|{}` literal in the file is flagged, even in unrelated functions. This will false-positive on legitimate defaults (e.g. `value ?? 0`). Require literal and check-function on same line/scope or within same function body.

Diverges from `gates/orphan_scan.sh` (searches `ao-client/ package.json`, handles `gen/routes.ts`). Resolve base per-ref via `<remote-sha>..<local-sha>`, loop all refs, use NUL/`while read`, anchor stem match.

comments.content: Permissive evidence fallback: `[A-Za-z0-9_/.-]+:[0-9]+` accepts `a:1`, `12:30` (time) as file:line evidence, and `[a-f0-9]{7,}` accepts `1234567` as sha. Bare `done/complete/shipped` claims bypass the keystone gate. Require word boundaries + realistic shapes (e.g. sha `\b[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b` with a letter, path with `/` or known extension). Line 65 is subsumed by line 66, making it dead.

 done <<< "$STDIN_LINES"
